title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering): Payment Limits and the Arrears Recovery Split
content:
**1. Accepted payments.** A payment to a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) account must be at least the tier's smallest single payment and at most its largest single payment, and must come through one of the tier's accepted payment channels. The tier is read from the enrollment's record.

**2. The split while arrears remain.** While the arrears balance is above zero, every payment other than the activation payment is split. The recovery portion is the tier's recovery percentage of the gross payment, rounded to the cent, but not less than the tier's smallest recovery portion per payment, never more than the arrears balance remaining and never more than the gross payment. The rest of the gross payment is credited to the prepaid balance.

**3. How the split is booked.** The recovery portion is booked as an arrears recovery carrying the same payment confirmation number, and the payment is marked as one from which a recovery portion was taken.

**4. No arrears.** When the arrears balance is zero the whole payment is credited to the prepaid balance, and the payment is marked as one from which no recovery portion was taken.

**5. Agency payments and automatic recharge.** An energy assistance agency payment is split the same way. Automatic recharges are ordinary payments of at least the tier's smallest automatic recharge amount, on tiers where automatic recharge is allowed.

### Figures by tier

| Tier | Smallest single payment | Largest single payment | Recovery percentage | Smallest recovery portion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 10.00 | 500.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 10.00 | 500.00 | 25 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 10.00 | 500.00 | 40 | 10.00 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 10.00 | 500.00 | 25 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 10.00 | 500.00 | 25 | 5.00 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 25.00 | 2000.00 | 0 | 0.00 |

### Worked splits (hypothetical payments)

| Tier | Arrears balance before | Gross payment | Percentage of gross, to the cent | Recovery portion | To prepaid balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 (25 percent, smallest portion 5.00) | 300.00 | 60.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 45.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 300.00 | 16.00 | 4.00 | raised to 5.00 | 11.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 (40 percent, smallest portion 10.00) | 6.00 | 50.00 | 20.00 | held to the 6.00 remaining | 44.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 200.00 | 10.00 | 4.00 | raised to 10.00, which equals the gross payment | 0.00 |
| any tier | 0.00 | 40.00 | not applicable | none | 40.00 |
